# nobus_fos_auth_details (Data Source)

Nobus FOS Swift-compatible endpoint and identity details.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nobus_fos_auth_details" "current" {}

output "fos_management_endpoint" {
  value = data.nobus_fos_auth_details.current.management_endpoint
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `identity_service_version` (Number)
- `management_endpoint` (String)
- `project_name` (String)
- `region` (String)
- `user_name` (String)
